title: SolarBench: A global solar energy nowcasting benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2609.06187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As the share of solar power grows, nowcasting weather-driven solar variability becomes critical for reliable energy system operation. State-of-the-art approaches increasingly apply deep learning to sky camera and geostationary satellite observations, but fragmented datasets and inconsistent evaluation make it difficult to determine whether reported improvements generalize across climates, cloud regimes, and photovoltaic (PV) systems. Here we introduce SolarBench, an open global benchmark for image-based solar nowcasting. SolarBench harmonizes more than six million sky and satellite images from 11 diverse sites spanning a decade, together with irradiance or PV output and auxiliary atmospheric data. An accompanying toolbox supports reproducible data access, processing, model development, and evaluation. translated_title: SolarBench：一个全球太阳能超短期预报基准
translated_abstract: 随着太阳能发电占比的不断提升，对天气驱动的太阳能变率进行超短期预报，已成为保障能源系统可靠运行的关键。最先进的方法越来越多地将深度学习应用于天空相机和地球静止卫星观测数据，但数据集的碎片化和评估标准的不一致，使得人们难以判断已报告的性能提升能否在不同气候、云况和光伏（PV）系统之间推广。在此，我们提出SolarBench，一个开放的、基于图像的全球太阳能超短期预报基准。SolarBench整合了来自11个多样化站点、跨越十年的超过六百万张天空和卫星图像，并配有辐照度或光伏输出数据以及辅助大气数据。配套的工具箱支持可复现的数据访问、处理、模型开发和评估。利用SolarBench，我们对代表性模型进行了基准测试，揭示了平均预报精度与捕捉快速变化能力之间的差距
tldr: SolarBench是一个开放的全球性太阳能超短期预报基准，整合了11个站点、跨越十年的超过六百万张天空与卫星图像及配套工具箱，为深度学习太阳能预报模型提供了统一、可复现的评估平台。
en_tdlr: SolarBench is an open global benchmark for image-based solar energy nowcasting, harmonizing over six million sky and satellite images from 11 diverse sites over a decade with a supporting toolbox, enabling unified and reproducible evaluation of deep learning solar forecasting models.
